Note: SW 0.1.6. lamp_matrix.vhd got two changes, both from the playfield measurement of 2026-08-10 (docs/Lamp_Preglow_Experiment.md 3): (1) blanking is now done by LATCHING ZEROS into the 595 instead of oe_n high-Z, so the ULN inputs never float - the original drives its row inputs from 9334 latches 100 percent of the time, so this removes a deviation rather than adding one, and it is therefore active in BOTH timing modes
column9: (2) the strobe now changes inside the blanking window, giving the Aux board's 2N5883 column driver ~20 us to turn off before the rows go live - Options DIP 5 = ON switches back to the original timing (strobe changes together with the row latch, pre-glow included). The +3 registers are the state one-hot growing from 7 to 8 states (new St_Settle) plus the two new flags pass and orig_mode
column10: both variants must show the same +3 and they do. Comb moved pcb +7 and dev_open +17 - the gap between the variants is 4 now (6 at 0.1.5), still the version nibble x5 -> x6 folding differently per variant, not a design change. Memory UNCHANGED at 202752, the acceptance criterion, because BRAM at 73 percent is the tight resource. Slack 3.172 -> 2.375: a 0.8 ns drop, inside the 1.5 ns tolerance check.ps1 applies, and the tight path is cpu_clk as always, not the lamp FSM. NEW expected warning: 10036 "lamp_blank assigned a value but never read" - the blank output is only consumed inside the gen_dbg4/gen_dbg5 blocks, so at DBG_MODE = 0 it is dangling by design, same family as dma_clk/audio_clk/nvram_wren. Earlier history kept for reference: 0.1.5 moved DWELL_CYCLES 12500 -> 25100 for the original 488 Hz lamp frame (+1 register for the wider dwell counter)
column11: 2026-08-09 lamp_matrix got St_ShiftLast (+1 register, +6 comb) so the 24th SRCK pulse is no longer 20 ns wide, docs/Lamp_Refresh_Analysis.md 6.7.1
column12: the jump from 2433/935 came with rtl/fa_control (LISY slave, 1700 ALUTs / 499 registers). Still 85 of 89 pins - DIP 5 needed no new pin, options(5) was already wired to dip_opt(3). Lead variant, hardware tested through SW 0.1.5: the 2026-08-10 pre-glow observation was run with 0.1.3, 0.1.4 AND 0.1.5 on the machine and all three behaved identically, which also settles that the 488 Hz frame of 0.1.5 runs on hardware - what is still open there is only the LA re-measurement of the 512 us raster (docs/Lamp_Refresh_Analysis.md 6.7). That the three versions look the same is itself evidence for the 0.1.6 diagnosis: 0.1.3/0.1.4 scan at 961 Hz and 0.1.5 at 488 Hz, so the artifact does not scale with DWELL_CYCLES - its width is set by the Aux board's column driver, exactly as claimed.
